title: 翠嶺の呼吸 ―原生林を駆ける軌跡―
author: 森閑 イオリ

en.title: Breath of the Verdant Peaks: Trails Through the Primeval Forest
en.premise: Having found solace only in the silence of nature, I am driven by a sudden impulse to enter a grueling trail running race. The scent of damp earth in the primeval forest, the pale bark of birch trees, the sight of Japanese serows leaping across the crags—as I push my body to its absolute limit, I learn that the goal is not to conquer nature, but to become a part of its eternal cycle. From an old coastal lighthouse, past oasis-like springs hidden among arid rocks, this is a story of the journey toward the summit.

zh.title: 翠岭之息：奔跑于原生林的轨迹
zh.premise: 习惯于在自然的静谧中寻找归属感的“我”，在一次冲动之下，决定挑战一场艰苦的越野跑大赛。原生林中湿润的泥土气息、白桦树洁白的树皮、在岩场间奔跑的日本羚羊……在挑战肉体极限的过程中，我逐渐领悟到，奔跑并非为了征服自然，而是为了成为自然循环的一部分。从海岸边的古老灯塔出发，跨越干涸岩块间如绿洲般的涌泉，这是一个向着顶峰进发的故事。
